response.original_title: The Cat Stays in the Picture
response.overview: An unnamed Hollywood starlet brings Tweety to her gala premiere. The canary makes faces at the photographers, one of who is actually Sylvester in disguise. He is beaten up by the Crusher. Sylvester sneaks into the theater anyway, but is caught when he gets stuck in bubble gum and popcorn. Next, Sylvester catches Tweety's bird cage. When he enters it, he is surprised to find himself in a no-holds fight between himself and the Crusher, who delivers moves that "banned [the Crusher] from wrestling in 49 states." Finally, Sylvester, disguised as an usher, takes Tweety to the projection booth. When the feline reveals himself, Tweety flies out of his cage and sticks Sylvester's tail in the projector, pulling the feline into the movie.
response.title: The Cat Stays in the Picture
